periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt of approximately 15 degrees toward the rostrum at the superior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio characterized by vertical elongation; the morphology is a distinct oval rather than circular.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering at the bottom edge, shifting the geometric center slightly above the vertical midpoint of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow V-shape profile at the posterior margin of the band as it crosses the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band comprising approximately 40% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation; the gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately double the width of an individual ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded parabolic curves at the ear tips with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown chromatic variance in the ventral fur compared to the brighter white cranial fur; right forelimb is flexed with the manus positioned near the mouth.
